purpose: Teach: 喜劇/白鳥/酒造/クジラ/雑学/落とし穴/飲み屋/平方メートル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、喜劇映画を観てきたんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of your regulars came in telling me they saw a comedy the other day.
lines.style: Warm and interested, leaning in slightly. Gentle tone, as if sharing something that reminded her of Mei. Soft pacing, natural breath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、白鳥のバレエに憧れてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And there was this little one who was so excited about wanting to dance Swan Lake someday.
lines.style: Tender attention on the child's dream. Soft, almost dreamlike pacing. Voice carries gentle admiration. Slight upward lift at the end, inviting Mei into the moment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、酒造の見学ツアーをされたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Another customer was telling me about this sake brewery tour they did — seemed really meaningful to them.
lines.style: Reflective, like she's turning the memory over in her mind. Moderate pace, thoughtful pauses. Noticing details that mattered. Quiet warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ホエールウォッチングでクジラを見たんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and someone actually saw whales on a whale-watching trip! Can you imagine?
lines.style: Bright and present. Slight energy lift on 'whales.' Speaking with genuine delight at the wonder of it. Quick, engaged pacing but not rushed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、雑学が豊富で楽しいよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your customers are so interesting — they always have these great stories and facts to share.
lines.style: Appreciative and genuine. Settled, comfortable tone. Speaking with quiet admiration for the people she serves. Even pacing, no hurry.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー考案、落とし穴に注意しましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Though I suppose when you're thinking up new menu ideas, you have to be careful not to overthink it.
lines.style: Gently cautious, almost conversational. A soft note of wisdom without lecturing. Steady pace. The tone of someone who's learned something the hard way.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、近所の飲み屋のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: One regular was telling me about this little tavern in the neighborhood — seemed like a special place to them.
lines.style: Reflective and warm. Noticing the significance of small, meaningful spaces. Gentle pacing. Voice carries understanding of why certain places matter to people.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の広さは何平方メートル位かしらね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've always wondered — how big is your shop, exactly? Like, how many square meters?
lines.style: Curious and gentle. Light, almost playful wondering tone. Speaking at close range, intimate and unguarded. A small smile in the voice.
